description: Verify that DHCPDISCOVER carries IPv4 source address = 0 prior to the client obtaining its address (RFC 2131 §4.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
In INIT the client has no IP, so the IPv4 src_ip on the wire must be 0.0.0.0. Setting any other value would advertise an IP the client doesn't own — confusing routers and breaking duplicate-detection logic.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER
   • IPv4 src_ip == 0.0.0.0   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DISCOVER's IPv4 src_ip is 0.0.0.0.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_source_ip_not_zero — DISCOVER src_ip is not zero (state-leak from prior bound lease)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_source_ip_not_zero: DUT DHCPDISCOVER source IP is not zero
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
